name: pact-protocol-whitepaper
description: Whitepaper PDF build for the PACT specification.

scripts.vectors:check: node vectors/check.mjs && node vectors/check-no-1x.mjs --selftest && node vectors/check-no-1x.mjs
scripts.publish: wrangler r2 object put pact-cloud-private/pact-whitepaper.pdf --file dist/pact-whitepaper.pdf --remote && wrangler r2 object put pact-cloud-private/pact-whitepaper.meta.json --file dist/pact-whitepaper.meta.json --content-type application/json --remote
